note.message: waits for apt to read APT source docker on web: apt cannot find docker-ce (unable to locate package), which may come from it
note.hint: apply the plan that runs apt-get update again for the source (MAM-PLAN-0152; mamelacd with sync = "push" applies it at its next poll); the next plan installs the package, or blocks it if apt still cannot find it once the source is read (check the package's name and the source's suites and components)

diffs.to: apt reads the package lists of every source again (apt-get update)

decision.message: adds an APT source and the key that signs it on the node as root, and runs apt-get update: apt then installs packages of this source too, a package of it with a higher version replaces the system's own (apt installs the highest version), and its maintainer scripts run as root
decision.hint: check the URIs and the key's sha256 against the vendor's instructions; a package of this source is installed only from an origin the policy allows (allowedAptOrigins) and the node's mamelet allows (allowedOrigins in /etc/mamelet/config.json)

note.message: the files of APT source docker are in place on web, but apt has not read https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu noble: an apt-get update failed, or has not run since they were written
note.hint: applying runs apt-get update again (approve this plan, or run apply again on the plan whose update failed); the result of the last attempt says why it failed
